source: 1. What is the logical memory space? ZXNAME0000XZ names spaces such as register, local, shared, and global memory. Those names describe visibility, lifetime, and programming semantics, not a simple physical ladder.[1]
zh: 1、什么是逻辑内存空间？ ZXNAME0000XZ 命名空间，例如寄存器、本地、共享和全局内存。这些名称描述了可见性、生命周期和编程语义，而不是简单的物理阶梯。[1]
